cards.claim: Manuel da Cruz is a man of the cloth and his duties as a priest often took him beyond the confines of the village church.
cards.quote: As the sun set over the rolling hills of rural France, Manuel da Cruz, a man of the cloth, made his way through the winding streets of the small village. His worn, black boots clicked against the cobblestone pavement, a rhythmic accompaniment to the soft rustling of his priestly robes. The villagers, familiar with the Portuguese prelate's gentle nature, nodded in respect as he passed, their faces creasing into warm smiles. Manuel's duties as a priest often took him beyond the confines of the village church, into the surrounding countryside.

raw_card.claim: Manuel da Cruz was a Portuguese prelate who served as a Catholic priest.
